question: The cost price of an item is one-fourth of its selling price. What is the gain or loss percentage on that item?
solution:

The cost price of an item is one-fourth of its selling price.

**Formula Used:**

Gain percentage = (frac{{{{Selling Price}} - {{Cost Price}}}}{{{{Cost Price}}}}) times 100
